meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你的计划拆成多个阶段,轮流派出专门的子代理去实施、检查和提交,自己只负责统筹调度,不直接动手。
howto.when: 当你说要执行、运行或实施某个计划时触发,尤其是 make-plan 生成的计划。

say.note: Claude 会开始按阶段分批派出子代理。

say.text: 运行 make-plan 生成的计划。
say.note: Claude 会按计划的阶段依次调度子代理。

say.text: 帮我实施第2阶段的计划。
say.note: Claude 会只推进该阶段并完成验证。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude breaks your plan into phases and deploys dedicated subagents to implement, verify, and commit, while it only orchestrates, routes context, and checks completion.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.note: Claude will deploy subagents phase by phase.

say_en.text: Run the plan generated by make-plan.
say_en.note: Claude will schedule subagents according to the plan.

say_en.text: Help me implement phase 2 of the plan.
say_en.note: Claude will only advance that phase and verify it.
